verdict.rationale: Drata publishes a public GitHub repository for its endpoint component, drata-agent, with build-from-source instructions, so part of the product's source is readable (drata-gh-5, drata-gh-2). Nothing shows the license that repo is under, and nothing suggests the core compliance platform's source is available. Missing for 10: evidence of an open license on the agent repo, open source for the core SaaS platform, independent corroboration.
